scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mbc360/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @mbc360/shared" "npm run dev -w @mbc360/api" "npm run dev -w @mbc360/web"
scripts.db:setup: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d && npm run db:migrate -w @mbc360/api && npm run db:seed -w @mbc360/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mbc360/shared && npm run build -w @mbc360/api && npm run build -w @mbc360/web
